steps.say: TB screening is mandatory before any biologic or JAK inhibitor. An IGRA blood test with a chest film is performed in every starter. Positive blood with a clean film is treated as latent disease. Symptoms with shadows are treated as active tuberculosis.
steps.tx: **Latent TB screening** pairs an **IGRA** (QuantiFERON or T-SPOT) with a baseline **chest radiograph** before any biologic or **JAK inhibitor**. Positive blood with a clean film means latent infection for preventive therapy, while cough, weight loss, or shadows mean active disease for full treatment first. This figure is the display of the granuloma standoff. No first biologic dose goes in without both results filed.

vis.alt: Diagram showing airborne M. tuberculosis transmission, initial pulmonary alveolar granuloma formation, and latent versus active infection outcomes.
vis.caption: Latent TB: granuloma contains bacilli until immunity slips. IGRA with chest film screens every starter. Image: Wenping Gong and Xueqiong Wu, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.say: Three preventive regimens are approved when latent TB is found. Rifampin daily for 4 months is the shortest simple course. Weekly isoniazid with rifapentine for 12 weeks is the shortest supervised course. Daily isoniazid for 9 months with pyridoxine is the oldest effective course. Biologics are delayed one month after the start.
steps.tx: Latent TB takes one of three sterilizing courses: **rifampin 600 mg** daily for **4 months**, weekly **isoniazid 900 mg** with **rifapentine 900 mg** for **12 weeks** (with **pyridoxine** against neuropathy in the long courses), or **isoniazid 300 mg** daily for **9 months**. Liver tests run through every course. Biologics wait at least **1 month** after preventive therapy starts, because cover must precede immunosuppression.

steps.say: Hepatitis B screening is mandatory before immunosuppression. HBsAg with anti-HBc and anti-HBs is measured by serological panels in every starter. Positive surface or core with rituximab is treated with antivirals first. Entecavir or tenofovir is continued 12 to 18 months after depletion.
steps.tx: **Hepatitis B serology** (HBsAg, **anti-HBc**, anti-HBs) precedes every immunosuppressant. Surface- or core-positive patients facing **rituximab** start **entecavir** or **tenofovir** before depletion and run it **12 to 18 months** after B cells return, because reactivation fulminates. This figure is the display of the marker timeline. Hepatitis C with HIV screens ride along, and antivirals never wait for viral loads to rise.

vis.alt: Dane particle virion diagram, serum marker concentration curves over weeks, window period shading, chronic hepatitis B inset graph.
vis.caption: HBV serology timeline: surface antigen with core antibody marks infection phases. Screen before rituximab, cover 12 to 18 months. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis is required with heavy steroids plus a second agent. Prednisone above 20 mg daily for weeks is combined with cyclophosphamide or another drug. Single-strength daily or double-strength thrice weekly is prescribed as trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. Sulfa allergy is switched to dapsone or atovaquone.
steps.tx: High **Pneumocystis jirovecii** risk earns **trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole**: one **single-strength** tablet daily or one **double-strength** tablet thrice weekly. Cover starts when **prednisone** at or above **20 mg** daily across **4 to 8 weeks** joins another immunosuppressant or **cyclophosphamide**. Dapsone with atovaquone substitutes for sulfa allergy, and prophylaxis runs as long as the double hit lasts.

nodes.label: Preventive antibiotic daily or thrice weekly

steps.say: Live attenuated vaccines are banned on biologics and high-dose steroids. MMR with varicella, yellow fever, and oral polio is withheld during therapy. Vaccine-strain replication is feared without immune control. Contacts are given inactivated polio instead.
steps.tx: **Live-attenuated vaccines** (**MMR**, **varicella**, yellow fever, oral polio, live zoster) are forbidden on biologics, JAK inhibitors, and high-dose steroids, because crippled virus replicates wild without immune brakes. Vaccinate first, immunosuppress after. Household contacts take inactivated polio while the patient is treated, keeping wild virus out of the house.

steps.say: Shingles prevention is offered to every immunosuppressed adult. Recombinant zoster vaccine is given from 50 years, or 18 years with immune compromise. Two doses 2 to 6 months apart are injected intramuscularly. Therapy is continued through vaccination without pause.
steps.tx: **Shingrix** (RZV), an adjuvanted non-live subunit, prevents shingles during immunosuppression: two intramuscular doses **2 to 6 months** apart for all adults from **50 years**, and for immunocompromised patients from **18 years**. No pause in therapy is needed, unlike live zoster which is banned. Post-herpetic neuralgia avoided is the prize.

nodes.label: Age 50 plus, or 18 plus at risk

steps.say: Pneumococcal vaccination is completed before immunosuppression whenever feasible. One PCV20 shot alone is given as the simple schedule. PCV15 followed 8 weeks later by PPSV23 is given as the two-step schedule. Protection is confirmed before the first biologic dose.
steps.tx: **Pneumococcal vaccination** takes one **PCV20** shot alone, or **PCV15** followed at least **8 weeks** later by **PPSV23**. Conjugate primes with polysaccharide broadening cover, and pre-immunosuppression timing works best. One PCV20 visit beats three, so the simple schedule wins whenever stocks allow.

steps.say: Rituximab is the wiper of vaccine responses for months. Non-live vaccines are completed 2 to 4 weeks before the infusion. Delayed vaccination is set 5 to 6 months after the last dose. B-cell return after depleting therapy is awaited before revaccination.
steps.tx: **Rituximab** blunts vaccine responses by emptying B cells: finish non-live vaccines **2 to 4 weeks** before infusion, or hold them until **5 to 6 months** after the last dose when B cells reconstitute. This figure is the display of the prevention bundle. Infusion dates diary the vaccination calendar, and household immunization fills the shield gap.
